text.body: <1> pātrāṇi sūtradhāraḥ naṭī vijayā --- pratihārī | kāñcukīyaḥ --- avadātikā --- ceṭī sītāyāḥ | sītā --- rāmapatnī | rāmaḥ --- daśarathasya jyeṣṭaḥ putraḥ | lakṣmaṇaḥ --- daśarathasya putraḥ bharataḥ --- daśarathasya putraḥ | śatrughnaḥ --- daśarathasya putraḥ rājā daśarathaḥ --- kosalādhipaḥ | nandinikā --- aparā ceṭī sītāyāḥ | ceṭī sumantraḥ --- daśarathasya sārathiḥ | kausalyā --- daśarathasya paṭṭamahiṣī --- rāmasya jananī | sumitrā --- daśarathasya mahiṣī --- mātā lakṣmaṇasya śatrughnasya ca | kaikeyī --- daśarathasya mahiṣī --- mātā bharatasya | sudhākaraḥ --- bhaṭaḥ --- devakulikaḥ --- pratimāgṛharakṣakaḥ sūtaḥ --- bharatasya tāpasī --- rāvaṇaḥ --- rākṣasarājaḥ--- laṅkeśvaraḥ vṛddhatāpasau nandilakaḥ ca --- janasthānavāsinaḥ pratimānāṭakam sthāpanā| nāndyante tataḥ praviśati sūtradhāraḥ|) sūtradhāraḥ sītābhavaḥ pātu sumantratuṣṭaḥ sugrīvarāmaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaśrca| yo rāvaṇāryapratimaśrca devyā vibhīṣaṇātmā bharato'nusargam||1|| (nepathyābhimukhamavalokya|) āryeeṃ, itastāvat| (praviśya) naṭī --- ayya iāmhi| (ārya, iyamasmi|) sūtradhāraḥ --- āryeṃ, idamevedānīṃ śaratkālamadhikṛtya gīyatāṃ tāvat| naṭī --- ayya, taha| (gāyati|)(ārya, tathā) sūtradhāraḥ --- asmin hi kāle carati pulineṣu haṃsī kāśāṃśukavāsinī susaṃhṛṣṭā| (nepathye) ayya, ayya| (ārya, āya|) (ākaṇrya|) sūtradhāraḥ --- bhavatu vijñātam muditā narendrabhavane tvaritā pratihārarakṣīva||2|| (niṣkrāntau|) sthāpanā| prathamo'ṅkaḥ (praviśya|) pratibārī --- ayya ko iha kañcuīāṇaṃ saṃṇihido| (ārya ke iha kāñcukīyānāṃ saṃnihitaḥ|) kāñcukīyaḥ --- bhavati, ayamasmi| kiṃ kriyatām| pratihārī --- ayya! mahārāo devāsurasaṅgāmesu appaḍihadamāraho dasaraho āṇavedisigdhaṃ bhaṭṭidāraassa rāmassa rajjappahāva,ñjoakāraā ahiseasambhārā āṇīantu tti| (ārya, mahārājo devāsurasaṅgrāmeṣvapratihatamahāratho daśaratha ājñāpayati| śīghraṃ bhartṛdārakasya rāmasya rājyaprabhāvasaṃyogakārakā abhiṣekasambhārā ānīyantāmiti|) kāñcukīyaḥ --- bhavati, yadājñaptaṃ mahārājena, tat sarvamupasthāpitam| paśya| chatraṃ savyajanaṃ sanandipaṭahaṃ bhadrāsanaṃ kalpitaṃ nyastā hemamayāḥ sadarbhakusumāstīrthāmbupūrṇā ghaṭāḥ| yuktaḥ puṣyarathaśrca mantrisahitāḥ paurāḥ samabhyāgatāḥ sarvasyāsya hi maṅgalaṃ sa bhagavān vedyāṃ vasiṣṭhaḥ sthitaḥ|| 3|| pratihārī --- jai evvaṃ, sohaṇaṃ kidaṃ| (yadyevaṃ, śobhanaṃ kṛtam|) kāñcukīyaḥ --- hanta bhoḥ idānīṃ bhūmipālena kṛtakṛtyāḥ kṛtāḥ prajāḥ| rāmābhidhānaṃ medinyāṃ śaśāṅkamabhiṣiñcatā||4|| pratihārī --- tuvaradu tuvaradu dāṇi ayyo| (tvaratāṃ tvaratāmidānīmāryaḥ|) kāñcukīyaḥ --- bhavati! idaṃ tvaryate| (niṣkrāntaḥ) pratihārī --- (parikramyāvalokya)ayya! saṃbhavaa! saṃbhavaa! gaccha tuvaṃ tuvaṃ pi mahārāavaaṇeṇa ayyapurohidaṃ jahopaāreṇa tuvārehi| (anyato gatvā|) sārasie! sarasie! saṅgīdayālaṃ gacchia nāḍaīāṇaṃ viṇṇevehikālasaṃvādiṇā ṇāḍaeṇa sajjā hoha tti| jāva ahaṃ vi savvaṃ kidaṃ tti mahārāassa ṇivedemi| (niṣkrāntā|) (ārya! sambhavaka! sambhavaka! gaccha, tvamapi mahārājavacanenāryapurohitaṃ yathopacāreṇa tvaraya| anyato gatvā sārasike! sārasike! saṅgītaśālāṃ gatvā nāṭakīyānāṃ vijñāpayakālasaṃvādinā nāṭakena sajjā bhavateti| yāvadahamapi sarvaṃ kṛtamiti mahārājāya nivedayāmi|) avadātikā --- aho accāhidaṃ| parihāmeṇa vi hamaṃ vakkalaṃ uvaṇaantīe mama etiaṃ āsī, kiṃ puṇa lobheṇa paradhaṇaṃ harantassa| hasiduṃ via icchami| ṇa khu eāiṇīe hasidavvaṃ| (aho atyāhitam| parihāsenāpīmaṃ valkalamupanayantyā mamaitāvad bhayamāsīt kiṃ punarlobhena paradhanaṃ harataḥ| hasitumivecchāmi| na khalvekākinyā hasitavyam|) sītā --- hañje, odādīa parisaṅkidavaṇṇā via dissai| kiṃ ṇu hu via edaṃ| (hañje, avadātikā pariśaṅkitavarṇeva dṛśyate| kinnu khalvivaitat|) ceṭī --- bhaṭṭiṇi! sulahāvarāho pariaṇe ṇāma| avarajjhā bhavissadi| (bhaṭṭini, sulabhāparādhaḥ! parijano nāma| aparāddhā bhaviṣyati|) sītā --- ṇahi ṇahi| hasiduṃ via icchadi| (nahi nahi, hasitumivecchati|) avadātikā --- (upasṛtya|) jedu bhaṭṭiṇī! bhaṭṭiṇi ṇa su ahaṃ avarajjhā| (jayatu bhaṭṭinī, bhaṭṭini! na khalvahamaparāddhā|) sītā --- kā tumaṃ pucchadi| odādie! kiṃ edaṃ vāmahatthaparigahidaṃ | (kā tvāṃ pṛcchati| avadātike! kimetad vāmahastaparigṛhītam|) avadātikā --- bhaṭṭiṇi! idaṃ vakkalaṃ| (bhaṭṭini! idaṃ valkalam|) sītā --- vakkalaṃ kissa āṇīdaṃ| (valkalaṃ kasmādānītam|) avadātikā --- suṇādu bhaṭṭiṇī| ṇevacchapāliṇī ayyarevā ṇivvuttaraṅgappaoaṇaṃ asoarukkhassa ekkaṃ kisalaaṃ amhehi jāidā āsi| ṇa a tāe diṇṇaṃ| tado arihadi avarāho tti idaṃ gāhidaṃ| (śṛṇotu bhaṭṭinī| nopathyapālinyāryarevā nivṛttaraṅgaprayojanamaśokavṛkṣasyaikaṃ kisalayamasmābhiryācitāsīt| na ca tayā dattam| tato'rhatyaparādha itīdaṃ gṛhītam|) sūtā --- pāvaaṃ kidaṃ| gaccha, ṇiyyodehi| (pāpakaṃ kṛtam| gaccha, niryātaya|) avadātikā --- bhaṭṭiṇi! parihāsaṇimittaṃ khu mae edaṃ āṇīdaṃ| (bhaṭṭini! parihāsanimittaṃ khalu mayaitadānītam|) sītā --- ummattie! evaṃ doso vaḍḍhai| gaccha ṇiyyādehi, ṇiyyādehī| (unmattike! evaṃ doṣo vardhate| gaccha, niryātaya, niryātaya|) avadātikā --- jaṃ bhaṭṭiṇī āṇavedi| (yad bhaṭṭinyājñāpayati|) (prasthātumicchati|) sītā --- halā! ehi dāva| (halā! ehi tāvat|) avadātikā --- bhaṭṭiṇi! iamhi| (bhaṭṭini! iyamasmi|) sītā --- halā! kiṃ ṇu mama vi dāva sohadi| (halā! kinnu khalu mamāpi tāvat śobhate|) avadātikā --- bhaṭṭiṇi! savvasovaṇīaṃ surūvaṃ ṇāma| alaṅkarodu bhaṭṭiṇī (bhaṭṭini! sarvaśobhanīyaṃ surūpaṃ nāma! alaṅkarotu bhaṭṭinī|) sītā --- aṇohi gāva| halā! pekkha, kiṃ dāṇiṃ sohadi| (ānaya tāvat| (gṛhītvālaṃkṛtya|) halā! paśya, kimidānīṃ śobhate)? avadātikā --- tava khu sohadiṇāma| sovaṇṇiaṃ via vakkalaṃ saṃvuttaṃ| (tava khalu śobhate nāma| sauvarṇikamiva valkalaṃ saṃvṛttam|) sītā --- hañje! tuvaṃ kiñci ṇa bhaṇāsi| (hañje! tvaṃ kiñcinna bhaṇasi|) ceṭī --- ṇatthi vāāe paoaṇaṃ| ime paharisidā taṇūruhā mantenti| (pulakaṃ darśayati|)(nāsti vācā prayojanam| imāni praharṣitāni tanūruhāṇi mantrayante|) sītā --- hañje ādaṃsaaṃ dāva āṇehi!(hañje! ādarśaṃ tāvadānaya|) ceṭī --- jaṃ bhaṭṭiṇī āṇavedi| (niṣkramya praviśya|)bhaṭṭiṇi! aaṃ ādaṃsao| (yad bhaṭṭinyājñāpayatti| bhaṭṭini! ayamādarśaḥ|) ceṭī --- (ceṭīmukhaṃ vilokya) ciṭhṭhadu dāva ādaṃsao| tuvaṃ kiṃ vi vattukāmā via| (tiṣṭhatu tāvadādarśaḥ| tvaṃ kimapi vaktukāmeva|) ṭeṭī --- bhaṭṭiṇi, evaṃ mae sudaṃ| ayyabālāī kañcuī bhaṇādi --- ahiseo ahiseo tti| (bhaṭṭini!evaṃ mayā śrutam| āryabālākiḥ kañcukī bhaṇati --- abhiṣeko'bhiṣeka iti|) sītā --- koni bhaṭṭā rajje bhavissatti| (kopi bhartā rājye bhaviṣyati|) (praviśyāparā) ceṭī --- bhaṭṭiṇi! piakkhāṇiaṃ piakkhāṇiaṃ| (bhaṭṭini, priyākhyānikaṃ priyākhyānikam|) sītā --- kiṃ kiṃ paḍicchia mantesi| (kiṃ kiṃ pratīṣya mantrayase|) ceṭī --- bhaṭṭidārao kila ahisiñcīadi| (bhartṛdārakaḥ kilābhiṣicyate|) sītā --- avi tādo kusalī| (api tātaḥ kuśalī|) ceṭī --- mahārāeṇa evva ahisiñjīadi| (mahārājenaivābhiṣicyate|) sītā --- jai evaṃ dudīaṃ me piaṃ sudaṃ| visāladaraṃ ucchaṅgaṃkārehi| (yadyevaṃ, dvitīyaṃ me priyaṃ śrutam| viśālataramutsaṅge kuru|) ceṭī --- bhaṭṭiṇi! taha| (tathā karoti|) (bhaṭṭini! tathā|) (sītā ābharaṇānyavamucya dadāti|) ceṭī --- bhaṭṭiṇi! paṭahasaddo via | (bhaṭṭini! paṭahaśabda iva|) sītā --- so evvaṃ (sa eva) ceṭī --- ekkapade odyaṭṭīa tuhṇīo paṭahasado saṃvutto| (ekapade avaghaṭṭita tūṣṇīkaḥ paṭahaśabdaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ|) sītā --- ko ṇu khu ugdhādo ahiseassa| ahava bahuvuttantāṇi rāaulāṇi ṇāma| (ko nu khalūdghāto'bhiṣekasya| athavā bahuvṛttāntāni rājakulāni nāma|) ceṭī --- bhaṭṭiṇi, evaṃ mae sudaṃbhaṭṭidāraaṃ ahisiñcia mahārāo vaṇaṃ gamissadi tti| (bhaṭṭini! evaṃ mayāśrutaṃbhartṛdārakamabhiṣicya mahārājo vanaṃ gamiṣyatīti|) sītā --- jai evvaṃ, ṇa so ahiseodao muhodaaṃ ṇāma| (yadyevaṃ, na tadabhiṣekodakaṃ, mukhodakaṃ nāma|) (tataḥ praviśati rāmaḥ|) rāmaḥ --- hanta bhoḥ| ārabdhe paṭahe sthite gurujane bhadrāsane laṅghite skandhoccāraṇanamyamānavadanapracyotitoye ghaṭe | rājñāhūya visarjite mayi jano dhairyeṇa me vismitaḥ svaḥ putraḥ kurute pituryadi vacaḥ kastatra bhoḥ! vismayaḥ || 5 || avadātikā --- bhaṭṭiṇi! bhaṭṭidārao khu āacchai| ṇāvaṇīdaṃ vakkalaṃ| (bhaṭṭini! bhartṛdārakaḥ khalvāhacchati| nāpanītaṃ valkalam|) rāmaḥ --- maithili! kimāsyate| sītā --- haṃ ayyaṭhatto| jedu ayyautto| (haṃ āryaputraḥ| jayatvāryaputraḥ|) rāmaḥ --- maithili! āsyatām| (upaviśati|) sītā --- jaṃ ayyautto āṇavedi| (upaviśati|) (yad āryaputra ājñāpayati|) avadātikā --- bhaṭṭiṇi! so evva bhaṭṭidāraassa veso| aliaṃ via edaṃ bhave| (bhaṭṭini! sa eva bhartṛdārakasya veṣaḥ| alīkamivaitad bhavet|) sītā --- tādiso jaṇo aliaṃ ṇa mantedi| ahava bahuvuttantāṇi rāaulāṇi ṇāma| (tādṛśo jano'līkaṃ na mantrayate| athavā bahuvṛttāntāni rājakulāni nāma|) rāmaḥ --- maithili! kimidaṃ kathyate| sītā --- ṇa khu kiñci| iaṃ dāriā bhaṇādi --- ahiseo ahiseo tti|(na khalu kiṃcit| iyaṃ dārikā bhaṇatiabhiṣeko'bhiṣeka iti|) rāmaḥ --- avagacchami te kautūhalam| astyabhiṣekaḥ| śrūyatām| adyāsmi mahārājenopādhyāyā mātyaprakṛtijanasamakṣamekaprakārasaṃkṣiptaṃ kosalarājyaṃ kṛtvā bālyastamaṅkāmāropya mātṛgotraṃ snigdhamābhāṣya putra! pratigṛhyatā rājyamityuktaḥ| rājyam ityuktaḥ| sītā --- tadāṇīṃ ayyautteṇa kiṃ bhaṇidaṃ| (tadānīmāryaputreṇa kiṃ bhaṇitam|) rāmaḥ --- maithili! tvaṃ tāvat kiṃ tarkayasi| sītā --- takkemi ayyautteṇa abhaṇia kiñci digdhaṃ ṇissasie mahārāassa pavādamūlesu paḍiaṃ tti| (tarkayāmyāryaputreṇābhaṇitvā kiñcid dīrghaṃ niḥśvasya mahārājasya pādamūlayoḥ patitamiti|) rāmaḥ --- suṣṭhu tarkitam| alpaṃ tulyaśīlāni dvandvani sṛjyante| tatra hi pādayorasmi patitaḥ| samaṃ bāṣpeṇa patatā tasyopari mamāpyadhaḥ| piturme kleditau pādau mamāpi kleditaṃ śiraḥ||6|| sītā --- tado tado| (tatastataḥ|) rāmaḥ --- tato'pratigṛhmamāṇoṣvanunayeṣu āsannajarādoṣaiḥ svai prāṇairasmi śāpitaḥ| sītā --- tado tado| (tatastataḥ|) rāmaḥ --- tatastadānīṃ, śatrughnalakṣmaṇagṛhītaghaṭe'bhiṣeke chatre svayaṃ nṛpatinā rudatā gṛhīte| sambhrāntayā kimapi mantharayā ca karṇe rājñaḥ śanairabhihitaṃ ca na cāsmi rājā||7|| sītā --- piaṃ me| mahārāo evva mahārāo, ayyautto evva ayyautto| (priyaṃ me| mahārāja eva mahārājaḥ, āryaputra evāryaputraḥ|) rāmaḥ --- maithili, kimarthaṃ vimuktālaṅkārāsi| sītā --- ṇa khu dāva, āvajjhāmi| (na tāvad, ābadhnāmi|) rāmaḥ --- na khalu| pratyagrāvatāritairbhūṣaṇairbhavitavyam| tathāhi karṇau tvarāpahṛtabhūṣaṇabhugnapāśau saṃsraṃsitābhaṃraṇagauratalau ca hastau| etāni cābharaṇabhāranatāni gātre sthānāni naiva samatāmupayānti tāvat || 8 || sītā --- pāredi ayyautto aliaṃ pi saccaṃ via manteduṃ| (pārayatyāryaputro'līkamapi satyamiva mantrayitum|) rāmaḥ --- tena hi alaṅkriyatām| ahamādarśaṃ dhārayiṣye| (tathā kṛtvā nirvaṇya|) tiṣṭha| ādarśe valkalānīva kimete sūryaraśmayaḥ| hasitena parijñātaṃ krīḍeyaṃ niyamaspṛhā || 9 || avadātike, kimetat| avadātikā --- bhaṭṭā! kiṇṇu hu sohadi ṇa sohaditti kodūhaleṇa āvajjhā| (bhartaḥ! kinnu khalu śobhate na śobhata iti kautūhalenābaddhāni|) rāmaḥ --- maithili! kimidam| iśvākūṇāṃ vṛddhālaṅkārastvayā dhāryate|astyasmākaṃ prītiḥ | ānaya| sītā --- mā khu mā khu ayyautto amaṅgalaṃ bhaṇādu| (mā khalu mā khalvāryaputro'maṅgalaṃ bhaṇatu|) rāmaḥ --- maithili, kimarthaṃ vārayasi| sītā --- ujjhidāhiseassa ayyauttassa amaṅgalaṃ via me paḍiādiṃ| (ujjhitābhiṣekasyāryaputrasyāmaṅgalamiva me pratibhāti|) rāmaḥ --- mā svayaṃ manyumutpādya parihāse viśeṣataḥ | śarīrārdhena me pūrvamābaddhā hi yadā tvayā || 10 || (nepathye) hā hā mahārājaḥ| sītā --- ayyautta! kiṃ edaṃ| (āryaputra, kimetat|) rāmaḥ --- (ākaṇrya) nārīṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ ca nirmaryādo yadā dhvaniḥ| suvyaktaṃ prabhavāmīti mūle daivena tāḍitam || 11 || tūrṇaṃ jñāyatāṃ śabdaḥ| (praviśya) kāñcukīyaḥ --- paritrāyatāṃ paritrāyatām| rāmaḥ --- ārya! kaḥ paritrātavyaḥ| kāñcukīyaḥ --- mahārājaḥ| rāmaḥ --- mahārāja iti| ārya! nanu vaktavyam, ekaśarīrasaṃkṣiptā pṛthivī rakṣitavyeti| atha kuta utpanno'yaṃ doṣaḥ| kāñcukīyaḥ --- svajanāt| rāmaḥ --- svajanāditi| hanta nāsti pratīkāraḥ| kāñcukīyaḥ --- tatrabhavatyāḥ kaikeyyāḥ| rāmaḥ --- kimambāyāḥ| tena hi udarkeṇa guṇenātra bhavitavyam| kāñcukīyaḥ --- kathamiva| rāmaḥ --- śrūyatāṃ, yasyāḥ śakrasamo bhartā mayā putravatī ca yā | phale kasmin spṛhā tasyā yenākāryaṃ kariṣyati || 13 || kāñcukīyaḥ --- kumāra! alamupahatāsu strībuddhiṣu svamārjavamupanikṣeptum| tasyā eva khalu vacanād bhavadabhiṣeko nivṛttaḥ| rāmaḥ --- ārya, guṇāḥ khalvatra| kāñcukīyaḥ --- kathamiva| rāmaḥ --- śrūyatāṃ, vanagamananivṛttiḥ pārthivasyaiva tāvanmama pitṛparavattā bālabhāvaḥ sa eva| navanṛpativimarśe nāsti śaṅkā prajānāmatha ca na paribhogairvañcitā bhrātaro me || 14 || kāñcukīyaḥ --- atha ca tayānāhūtopasṛtayā bharato'bhiṣicyatāṃ rājya ityuktam| atrāpyalobhaḥ| rāmaḥ --- āryaṃ! bhavān khalvasmatpakṣapātādeva nārthamavekṣate| kutaḥ, śulke vipaṇitaṃ rājyaṃ putrārthe yadi yācyate| tasyāḥ lobho'tra nāsmākaṃ bhrāturājyāpahariṇām || 15 || kāñcukīyaḥ --- atha rāmaḥ --- ataḥ paraṃ na mātuḥ parivādaṃ śrotumicchami| mahārājasya vṛttāntastāvadabhidhīyatām| kāñcukīyaḥ --- tatastadānīṃ, śokādavacanād rājñā hastenaiva visarjitaḥ kimapyabhimataṃ manye mohaṃ ca nṛpatirgataḥ || 16 || rāmaḥ --- kathaṃ mohamupagataḥ| (nepathye) kathaṃ kathaṃ mohamupagata iti| yadi na sahase rājño mohaṃ dhanuḥ spṛśaḥ mā dayā| rāmaḥ --- (ākaṇrya purato vilokya|) akṣobhyaḥ kṣobhitaḥ kena lakṣmaṇo dhairyasāgaraḥ| yena ruṣṭena paśyāmi śatākīrṇamivāgrataḥ || 17 || (tataḥ praviśti dhanurbāṇapāṇirlakṣmaṇaḥ|) lakṣamaṇaḥ --- (sakrodham|) kathaṃ kathaṃ mohamupagata iti| yadi na sahase rājño mohaṃ dhanuḥ spṛśa mā dayā svajananibhṛtaḥ sarvo'pyevaṃ mṛduḥ paribhūyate| atha na rucitaṃ muñca tvaṃ māmahaṃ kṛtaniśrcayo yuvatirahitaṃ lokaṃ kartuṃ yataśchalitā vayam || 18 || sītā --- ayyauta! rodidavve kāle somittiṇā dhaṇu gahīdaṃ apuvvo khu se āāso| (āryaputra! roditavye kāle saumitriṇā dhanurgṛhītam| apūrvaḥ khalvasyāyāsaḥ|) rāmaḥ --- sumitrāmātaḥ! kimidam| lakṣmaṇaḥ --- kathaṃ kathaṃ kiṃmidaṃ nāma| kramaprāpte hṛte rājye bhuvi śocyāsane nṛpe| idānīmapi sandehaḥ kiṃ kṣamā nirmanasvitā || 19 || rāmaḥ --- sumitrāmātaḥ! ayamasmi| rāmaḥ --- bhavataḥ sthairyamutpādayatā mayaivamabhihitam| ucyatāmidānīm| tāte dhanurnamayi satyamavekṣamāṇe muñcāni mātari śaraṃ svadhanaṃ harantyām| doṣeṣu bāhyamanujaṃ bharataṃ hanāni kiṃ roṣaṇāya ruciraṃ triṣu pātakeṣu || 22 || lakṣmaṇaḥ --- (sabāṇpam) hā dhik| asmānavijñāyopālabhase| yatkṛte mahatikrleśe rājye me na manorathaḥ| varṣāṇi kila vastavyaṃ caturdaśa vane tvayā || 23 || rāmaḥ --- atra mohamupahatastatrabhavān| hanta niveditamaprabhutvam| maithili! vāryatāmiyam| lakṣmaṇaḥ --- ārya notsahe ślāghanīye kāle vārayitumatrabhavatīm| kutaḥ anucarati śaśāṅkaṃ rāhudoṣe'pi tārā patati ca vanavṛkṣe yāti bhūmiṃ latā ca | tyajati na ca kareṇuḥ paṅkalagnaṃ gajendraṃ vrajatu caratu dharmaṃ bhartṛnāthā hi nāryaḥ || 25 || ceṭī --- jedu bhaṭṭiṇī| ṇevacchapāliṇī ayyarevā paṇamia viṇṇavediodādiāe saṅgīdasālādo acchindia vakkalā āṇīdā| imā avarā aṇaṇuhūdā vakkalā| ṇivvattīadu dāva kila paoaṇaṃ tti| (jayatu bhaṭṭinī| nepathyapālinyāryarevā praṇamya vijñāpayatiavadātikayā saṅgītaśālāyā ācchidya valkalā ānītāḥ| ame'parā ananubhūtā valkalāḥ| nirvatryatāṃ tāvat kila prayojanamiti|) rāmaḥ --- bhadre! vāryatāmayam| sītā --- somitte! ṇivattīadu kila| (saumitre! nivatryatāṃ kila|) lakṣmaṇaḥ --- ārye! gurorme pādaśuśruṣāṃ tvamekā kartumicchasi| tavaiva dakṣiṇaḥ pādo mama savyo bhaviṣyati || 27 || sītāḥ --- dīadu khu aruyyatto| santappadi sobhittī| (dīyatāṃ khalvāryaputraḥ| saṃtapyate saumitriḥ|) rāmaḥ --- saumitre! śrūyatām| valkalāni nāma, tapaḥ saṅgrāmakavacaṃ niyamadviradāṅkuśaḥ| khalīnamindriyāśvānāṃ gṛhyatāṃ dharmasārathiḥ || 28 || lakṣmaṇaḥ --- anugṛhīto'smi| (gṛhītvā paridhatte|) rāmaḥ --- śrutavṛttāntaiḥ pauraiḥ saṃniruddho rājamārgaḥ| utsāryatāmutsāryatāṃ tāvat| lakṣmaṇaḥ --- āryaṃ! ahamagrate yāsyāmi| utsāryatāmutsāryatām| rāmaḥ --- maithīli ! apanīyatāmavaguṇṭhanam| sītā --- jaṃ ayyautto āṇavedi|| (apanayati|) (yadāryaputra ājñāpayati|) rāmaḥ --- bho bhoḥ paurāḥ| śṛṇvantu śṛṇvantu bhavantaḥ| svairaṃ hi paśyantu kalatrametad bāṣpakulākṣairvadanairbhavantaḥ| nirdoṣaddaśyā hi bhavanti nāryo yajñe vivāhe vyasane vane ca || 29 || kāñcukīyaḥ --- kumāra! na khalu na khalu gantavyam | eṣa hi mahārājaḥ, śrutvā te vanagamanaṃ vadhūsahāyaṃ saubhrātravyavasitalakṣamaṇānuyātram| utthāya kṣititalareṇurūṣitāṅgaḥ kāntāradvirada ivopayāti jīrṇaḥ || 30 || lakṣmaṇaḥ --- ārya! cīramātrottarīyāṇāṃ kiṃ dṛśya vanavāsinām| rāmaḥ --- gateṣvasmāsu rājā na śirasthānāni paśyatu || 31 || (iti niṣkrāntāḥ sarve|) prathamo'ṅkaḥ | <2> (tataḥ praviśati kāñcukīyaḥ|) kāñcukīyaḥ --- bho bhoḥ pratihāravyāpṛtāḥ! sveṣu sveṣu sthāneṣvapramatā bhavantu bhavantaḥ! pratihārī --- ayya kiṃ edaṃ| (ārya! kimetat|) kāñcukīyaḥ --- eṣa hi mahārājaḥ satyavacanarakṣaṇaparaṃ rāmamaraṇyaṃ gacchantamupāvartayitumaśaktaḥ putravirahaśokāgninā dagdhahṛdaya unmatta iva bahu pralapan samudragṛhake śayānaḥ, meruścalanniva yugakṣayasannikarṣe śoṣaṃ vrajanniva mahodadhiraprameyaḥ| sūryaḥ patanniva ca maṇḍalamātralakṣyaḥ śokādbhṛśaṃ śithiladehamatinarendraḥ || 1 || pratihāri --- hā hā evvaṃgao mahārāo| (hā evaṃgato mahārājaḥ|) kāñcukīyaḥ --- bhavati! gaccha| pratihārīḥ --- ayya! taha| (ārya! tathā|) (niṣkāntā|) kāñcukīyaḥ --- (sarvato vilokya|) aho nu khalu rāmanirgamanadinādābhya śūnyaiveyamayodhyā saṃlakṣyate| kutaḥ, nāgendrā yavasābhilāṣavimukhāḥ sāsrekṣaṇā vājino heṣā śūnyamukhāḥ savṛddhavanitābālāśca paurā janāḥ| tyaktāhārakathāḥ sudīnavadanāḥ krandanta uccairdiśā rāmo yāti yayā sadārasahajastāmeva paśyantyamī || 2 || patatyutthāya cotthāya hā hetyuccairlapan muhuḥ| diśaṃ paśyati tāme va yayā yāto raghūdvahaḥ || 3 || (niṣkrāntaḥ|) miśraviṣkambhakaḥ| (tataḥ praviśati yathānirdiṣṭo rājā devyau ca|) rājā --- hā vatsa! rāma! jagatāṃ nayanābhirāma ! hā vatsa! lakṣmaṇa! sulakṣaṇasarvagātra! | hā sādhvi! maithili! patisthitacittavṛtte | hā hā gatāḥ kila vanaṃ bata me tanūjāḥ || 4 || citramidaṃ bhoḥ! yad bhrātṛsnehāt pitari vimuktasnehamapi tāvallakṣmaṇaṃ draṣṭumicchami| vadhu vaidehi| rāmeṇāpi parityakto lakṣmaṇena ca garhitaḥ| ayaśobhājanaṃ loke parityatktastvayāpyaham || 5 || satyasandha! sā eva mandabhāiṇī khu ahaṃ| (mahārāja! saiva mandabhāginī khalvaham|) rājā --- kausalye sāravatī khalvasi| tvatyā hi khalu rāmo garbhe dhṛtaḥ| ahaṃ hi duḥkhamatyantamasahyajvalanopamam | naiva soḍhuṃ na saṃhartu śaknomi muṣitendriyaḥ || 9 || (sumitrāṃ vilokya|) iyamaparā kā| kausalyā --- mahārāa! vacchalakkhaṇa| (mahārāja! vatsalakṣamaṇa) (ityardhokte) rājā --- (sahasotthāya) kvāsau kvāsau lakṣmaṇaḥ| na dṛśyate| bhoḥ kaṣṭam| (devyau sasambhramamutthāya rājānamavalambete|) kausalyā --- mahārāa! vacchalakkhaṇassa jaṇaṇī sumittatti vattuṃ mae uvakkandaṃ| (mahārāja! vatsalakṣaṇasya jananī sumitreti vaktuṃ mayopakrāntam|) rājā --- ayi sumitre| tavaiva putraḥ satputro yena naktandivaṃ vane | rāmo raghukulaśreṣṭhaśchāyayevānugamyate || 10 || (praviśya) kāñcukīyaḥ --- jayatu mahārājaḥ| eṣa khalu tatra bhavān sumantraḥ prāptaḥ| rājā --- (sahasotthāya saharṣam|) api rāmeṇa| kāñcukīyaḥ --- na khalu, rathena| rājā --- kathaṃ kathaṃ rathena kevalena| (iti mūÐcchataḥ patati|) devyau --- mahārāa! suṃtra eka eva nanu prāptaḥ| kāñcukīyaḥ --- mahārāja! atha kim| rājā --- kaṣṭaṃ bhoḥ| śūnyaḥ prāpto yadi ratho bhagno mama manorathaḥ | nūnaṃ daśarathaṃ netuṃ kālena preṣito rathaḥ || 11 || tena hi śīghraṃ praveśyatām| kāñcukīyaḥ --- yadājñāpayati mahārājaḥ| (niṣkāntaḥ|) rājā --- dhanyāḥ khalu vane vātāstaṭākaparivartinaḥ | vicarantaṃ vane rāmaṃ ye spṛśanti yathāsukham || 12 || (tataḥ praviśati sumantraḥ) sumantraḥ --- (sarvato vilokya saśokam|) ete bhṛtyāḥ svāni karmāṇi hitvā snehād rāme jātabāṣpākulākṣāḥ | cintādīnāḥ śokasaṃdagdhadehā vikrośantaṃ pārthivaṃ garhayanti || 13 || rājā --- bhrātaḥ| sumantra! kva me jyeṣṭho rāmaḥ --- nahi nahi yuktamabhihitaṃ mayā| kva te jyeṣṭho rāmaḥ priyasuta | sā kva duhitā videhānāṃ bharturniratiśayabhaktirgurujane | kva vā saumitrirmāṃ hatapitṛkamāsannamaraṇaṃ kimapyāhuḥ kiṃ te sakalajanaśokārṇavakaram || 14 || sumantraḥ --- mahārāja! mā maivamamaṅgalavacanāni bhāṣiṣṭhāḥ| acirādeva tān drakṣyasi| rājā --- satyamayuktamabhihitaṃ mayā| nāyaṃ tapasvināmucitaḥ praśnaḥ| tat kathyatām| api tapasvināṃ tapo vardhate| apyaraṇyāni svādhīnāni vicarantī vaidehī na parikhidyate| sumitrā --- sumanta! vahuvakkalāśaṅkidasarīrā vālā vi avāśacaritā bhattuṇo sahadhammaāriṇi amhe mahārāaṃ ca kiñci ṇālavadi| (samuntra! bahuvalkalālaṅkṛtaśarīrā bālāpyabālacāritrā bhartuḥ sahadharmacāriṇī asmān mahārājaṃ ca kiccinnālapati|) sumantraḥ --- sarva eva mahārājam rājā --- na na | śrotrarasāyanairmama hṛdayāturauṣadhaisteṣāṃ nāmadheyaireva śrāvaya| sumantraḥ --- yadājñāpayati mahārājaḥ| āyuṣmān rāmaḥ| rājāḥ --- rāma iti| ayaṃ rāmaḥ| tannāmaśravaṇāt spṛṣṭa iva me pratibhāti|tatastataḥ| sumantraḥ --- āyuṣmān lakṣmaṇaḥ| rājā --- ayaṃ lakṣmaṇaḥ | tatastataḥ| sumantraḥ --- āyuṣmatī sītā janakarājaputrī| rājā --- iyaṃ vaidehī| rāmo lakṣmaṇo vaidehītyayamakramaḥ| sumantraḥ --- ata kaḥ kramaḥ | rājā --- rāmo vaidehī lakṣmaṇa ityābhidhīyatām| rāmalakṣmaṇayormadhye tiṣṭhatvatrāpi maithilī | bahudoṣāṇyaraṇyāni sanāthaiṣā bhaviṣyati || 15 || sumantraḥ --- yadājñāpayati mahārājaḥ| āyuṣmāna rāmaḥ| rājā --- ayaṃ rāmaḥ| sumantraḥ --- āyuṣmatī janakarājaputrī| rājā --- ayaṃ lakṣmaṇaḥ| rāma! vaidehi! lakṣmaṇa! pariṣvajadhvaṃ māṃ putrakāḥ!| sakṛt spṛśāmi vā rāmaṃ sakṛt paśyāmi vā punaḥ | gatāyuramṛteneva jīvāmīti matirmama || 16 || sumantraḥ --- śrṛṅgiverapūre rathādavatīryāyodhyābhimukhaḥ sthitvā sarva eva mahārājaṃ śirasā praṇamya vijñāpayitumārabdhā| kamapyarthaṃ ciraṃ dhyātvā vaktuṃ prasphuritādharāḥ | bāṣpastambhitakaṇṭhatvādanuktvaiva vanaṃ gatāḥ || 17 || rājā --- kathamanuktvaiva vanaṃ gatāḥ| (iti dviguṇaṃ mohamupagataḥ|) sumantraḥ --- (sasambhramam) bālāke! ucyatāmamātyebhyaḥ apratīkārāyāṃ daśāyāṃ vartate mahārāja iti | kāñcukīyaḥ --- tathā| devyau --- mahārāa ! samassasihi samasssasihi| (mahārāja! samāśvasihi samāśvasihi|) rājā --- (kiñct isamāśvasya|) aṅgaṃ me spṛśa kausalye ! na tvāṃ paśyāmi cakṣuṣā| rāmaṃ prati gatā buddhiradyāpi na nivartate || 18 || putra!rāma! yat khalu mayā santataṃ cintitam| rājye tvāmabhiṣicya sannarapaterlābhāt kṛtārthāḥ prajāḥ kṛtvā tvatsahajān samānavibhavān kurvātmanaḥ santatam| ityādiśya ca te tapovanamito gantavyamityetayā kaikeyyā hi tadanyathā kṛtamaho niḥśeṣamekakṣaṇe || 19 || sumantra! ucyatāṃ kaikeyyāḥ gato rāmaḥ priyaṃ te'stu tyakto'hamapi jīvitaiḥ | kṣipramanīyatāṃ putraḥ pāpaṃ saphalamastviti || 20 || sumantraḥ --- yadājñāpayati mahārājaḥ | rājā --- (ūdhrvamavalokya|) aye rāmakathāśravaṇasandardhahṛdayaṃ māmāśvasayitumāgatāḥ pitaraḥ| ko'tra| (praviśya) kāñcukīyaḥ --- jayatu mahārājaḥ| rājā --- āpastāvat| kāñcukīyaḥ --- yadājñāpayati mahārājaḥ| (niṣkramya praviśya|) jayatu mahārājaḥ| rājā --- (ācamyālokya) ayamamarapateḥ sakhā dilīpo raghurayamatrabhavānajaḥ pitā me | kimabhigamanakāraṇaṃ bhavadbhi saha vasane samayo mamāpi tatra || 21 || rāma! vaidehi! lakṣmaṇa! ahamitaḥ pitṛṇāṃ sakāśaṃ gacchāmi| he pitaraḥ! ayamayamāgacchāmi| (mūcrchayā parāmṛṣṭāḥ|) (kāñcukīyo yavanikāstaraṇaṃ karoti|) sarve --- hā hā mahārāo| (hā hā mahārājaḥ| (nikrāntāḥ sarve|) dvitīyo'ṅkaḥ| <3> (tataḥ praviśati sudhākāraḥ|) sudhākāraḥ --- (samārjanādīni kṛtvā|) bhodu, dāṇi kidaṃ ettha kayyaṃ ayyasambhavaarasa āṇattaṃ| jāva muhuttaṃ suvissaṃ| (svapiti|) (bhavatu, idānīṃ kṛtamatra kāryamāryasambhavakasyājñaptam| yāvanmuhūrtaṃ svapsyāmi|) (praviśya) bhaṭaḥ --- (ceṭamupagamya tāḍayitvā|) aṅgho dāsīeputta! kiṃ dāṇi kammaṃ ṇa karesi| (tāḍayati|) (aṅgho dāsyāḥ putra! kimidānīṃ karma na karoṣi|) sudhākāraḥ --- (buddhavā tālehi maṃ tālehi maṃ (tāḍaya māṃ tāḍaya mām|) bhaṭaḥ --- tāḍīde tuvaṃ kiṃ karissasi| (tāḍite tvaṃ kiṃ kariṣyasi|) sudhākāraḥ --- ahaṇṇassa mma kattavī assa via bāhusahassaṃ ṇātthi| (aghanyasya mama kārtavīryasyeva bahusahasraṃ nāsti|) bhaṭaḥ --- bāhusahasseṇa kiṃ kayyaṃ? (bāhusahasreṇa kiṃ kāryam?) sudhāraḥ --- tuvaṃ haṇissaṃ| (tvaṃ haniṣyāmi|) bhaṭaḥ --- ehi dāsīeputa! mude muñcirasam| (punarapi tāḍayati|) (ehidāsyāḥ putra! mṛte mokṣyāmi|) sudhākāraḥ --- (rūditvā|) sakkaṃ dāṇi bhaṭṭā! me avarāhaṃ jāṇidum| (śakyamidānīṃ bhartaḥ me'parādhaṃ jñātum) bhaṭaḥ --- ṇatthi kila avarāho ṇatthi| ṇaṃ mae sandiṭṭho bhaṭṭidāraassa rāmassa rajjavibbhaṭṭhakisandāveṇa saggaṃ gaṭassa bhaṭṭiṇo dasarahassa paḍimāgehaṃ deṭṭhuṃ ajja kosalalāpuroehi savvehiṃ anteurehi iha āantavvaṃ tti| ettha dāṇi tuṣa kiṃ kidaṃ | (nāsti kilāparādho nāsti| nanu mayā sandiṣṭo bhartṛdārakasya rāmasya rājyavibhraṣṭakṛtasantāpena svargaṃ gatasya bharturdaśarathasya pratimāgehaṃ draṣṭumadya kausalyāpurogaiḥ sarvairantapurairihāgantavyamiti| atredānīṃ tvayā kiṃ kṛtam|) sudhākāraḥ --- pekkhadu bhaṭṭā| avaṇīdakavodasandāṇaaṃ dāva gabbhagihaṃ| sohavaṇṇaadattacandaṇapaḍhcāṅgulā bhittīo| osattamalaladānamasohīṇi duvārāṇi| paiṇṇā vāluā| ettha dāṇi mae kiṃ ṇa kidaṃ| (paśyatu bhartā apanītakapotasandānakaṃ tāvad garbhagṛham| saudhavarṇakadattacandanapañcāṅgulā bhittayaḥ| avasaktamālyadāmaśobhīni dvārāṇi| prakīrṇā vālukāḥ| atredānīṃ mayā kiṃ na kṛtam|) bhaṭaḥ --- ja evaṃ, vissatto gaccha| jāva ahaṃ vi savvaṃ kidaṃ tti amaccassa ṇivedemi| (yadyevaṃ, viśvasto gaccha| yāvadahamapi sarve kṛtamityamātyāya nivedayāmi|) (niṣkrāntau|) praveśakaḥ| bharataḥ --- (sāvegam|) sūta! ciraṃ mātulaparicayādavijñātavṛttānto'smi| śrutaṃ mayā dṛḍhamakalyaśarīro mahārāja iti| taducyatām piturme ko vyādhiḥ? sūtaḥ --- hṛdayaparitāpaḥ khalu mahān| bharataḥ --- kimāhustaṃ vaidyāḥ ? sūtaḥ --- na khalu bhiṣajastatra nipuṇāḥ| bharataḥ --- kimāhāraṃ bhuṅkteśayanamapi? sūtaḥ --- bhūmau niraśānaḥ bharataḥ --- kimāśā syād? sūtaḥ --- daivaṃ| bharataḥ --- sphurati hṛdayaṃ vāhaya ratham || 1 || sūtaḥ --- yadājñāpayatyāyuṣmān| (rathaṃ vāhayati|) bharataḥ --- (rathavegaṃ nirupya) aho nu khalu rathavegaḥ --- | ete te drumā dhāvantīva drutarathagatikṣīṇaviṣayā nadīvāddvṛttāmburnipatati mahī nemivavare | aravyaktirnaṣṭā sthitamiva javācchakravalayaṃ rajaścośvodbhūtaṃ patati purato nānupatati || 2 || sūtaḥ --- āyuṣman! sopasnehatayā vṛkṣāṇāmabhitaḥ khalvayodhyayā bhavitavyam| bharataḥ --- aho nu khalu svajanadarśanotsukasya tvaratā me manasaḥ | samprati hī, patitamiva śiraḥ pituḥ pādayoḥ snihyatevāsmi rājñā samutthāpitaḥ tvaritamupagatā iva bhrātaraḥ kledayantīva māmaśrubhirmātaraḥ| sadṛśa iti mahāniti vyāyataśceti bhṛtyairivāhaṃ stutaḥ sevayā parihasitamivātmanastatra paśyāmi veṣaṃ ca bhāṣāṃ ca saumitriṇā || 3 || sūtaḥ --- (ātmagatam) bhoḥ! kaṣṭam, yadayavijñāya mahārājavināśamudarke niṣphalāmāśāṃ parivahantyoedhyāṃ pravekṣyati kumāraḥ| jānadbhirapyasmābhirnanivedyate| kutaḥ, pituḥ prāṇaparityāgaṃ māturaiśvaryalubdhatām| jyeṣṭhabhrātuḥ pravāsaṃ ca trīn doṣān ko'bhidhāsyati || 4 || (praviśya) bhaṭaḥ --- jayatu kumāraḥ| bharataḥ --- bhadra! kiṃ śatrughno māmabhigataḥ| bhaṭaḥ --- abhigataḥ khalu vartate kumāraḥ| upādhyāyāstu bhavantamāhuḥ| bharataḥ --- kimiti kimiti| bhaṭaḥ --- ekanāḍikāvaśeṣaḥ kṛttikāviṣayaḥ| tasmāt pratipannāyāmeva rohiṇyāmayodhyāṃ pravekṣyati kumāraḥ| bharataḥ --- bāḍhamevam| na mayā guruvacanamatikrāntapūrvam| gaccha tvam| bhaṭaḥ --- yadājñāpayati kumāraḥ| (niṣkrāntaḥ) bharataḥ --- atha kasmin pradeśe viśramiṣye| bhavatu dṛṣṭam| etasmin vṛkṣāntarāviṣkṛte devakule muhūrtaṃ viśramiṣye tadubhayaṃ bhaviṣyati devatapūjā viśramaśca| atha ca upopaviśya praveṣṭavyāni nagarāṇīti satsamudācāraḥ| tasmāt sthāpyatāṃ rathaḥ| sūtaḥ --- yadājñāpayatyāyuṣmān| (rathaṃ sthāpayati|) bharataḥ --- (rathādavatīrya) sūta! ekānte viśrāmayāśvān| sūtaḥ --- yadājñāpayatyāyuṣmān| (niṣkrāntaḥ|) bharataḥ --- (kiñcid gatvāvalokya) sādhumuktapūṣyalājāviṣkṛtā balayaḥ, dattacandanapañcāṅgulā bhittayaḥ, avasaktamālyadāmaśobhīni dvārāṇi, prakīrṇā vālukāḥ| kinnu khalu pārvaṇo'yaṃ viśeṣa, athavā āÏhnakamāstikyam|kasya nu khalu daivatasya sthānaṃ bhaviṣyati| neha kiñcit praharaṇaṃ dhvajo vā bahiścihraṃ dṛśyate | bhavatu, praviśa jñāsye| (praviśyāvalokya) aho kriyāmādhuryaṃ pāṣāṇānām| aho bhāvagatirākṛtīnām| daivatodiṛṣṭānām| daivatodiṛṣṭānāmapi mānuṣaviśvāsatāsāṃ pratimānām| kinnu khalu caturdaivato'yaṃ stomaḥ| athavā yāni tāni bhavantu| asti tāvanme manasi praharṣaḥ| kāmaṃ daivatamityeva suktaṃ namayituṃ śiraḥ | vārṣalastu praṇāmaḥ syādamantrārcitadaivataḥ || 5 || (praviśya) devakulikaḥ --- bhoḥ! naityakāvasāne prāṇidharmamanutiṣṭhati mayi ko nu khalvayamāsāṃ pratimānāmalpāntarākṛtiriva pratimāgṛhaṃ praviṣṭaḥ| bhavatu, praviśya jñāsye (praviśati|) bharataḥ --- namostu| devakulikaḥ --- na khalu na khalu praṇāmaḥ kāryaḥ| bharataḥ --- mā tāvad bhoḥ ! vaktavyaṃ kiñcidasmāsu viśiṣṭaḥ pratipālyate | kiṅkṛtaḥ pratiṣedho'yaṃ niyamaprabhaviṣṇutā || 6 || devakulikaḥ --- na khalvetaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ pratiṣedhayāmi bhavantam| kintu daivataśaṅkyā brahmaṇajanasya praṇāmaṃ pariharāmi| kṣatriyā hmatrabhavantaḥ| bharataḥ --- evam| kṣatriyā hmatrabhavantaḥ| atha ke nāmātrabhavantaḥ| devakulikaḥ --- iśvākavaḥ| bharataḥ --- (saharṣama) iśvākava iti| ete te'yodhyābhartāraḥ| ete te daivatānāmasurapuravadhe gacchantyabhisarīmete te śakraloke sapurajanapadā yānti svasukṛtaiḥ | ete te prāpnuvantaḥ svabhujabalajitāṃ kṛtsnāṃ vasumatīmete te mṛtyunā ye ciramanavasitāśchandaṃ mṛgayatā || 7 || bhoḥ! yadṛcchayā khalu mayā mahat phalamāsāditam| abhidhīyatāṃ kastāvadatrabhavān| devakulikaḥ --- ayaṃ khalu tāvat sannihitasarvaratnasya viśvajito yajñasya pravartayitā prajvalitadharmapradīpo dilīpaḥ| bharataḥ --- namostu dharmaparāyaṇāya| abhidhīyatāṃ kastāvadatrabhavān| devakulikaḥ --- ayaṃ khalu tāvat saṃveśanotthāpanayoranekabrāhmaṇajanasahasraprayuktapuṇyāhaśabdaravo raghuḥ| bharataḥ --- aho balavān mṛtyuretāmapi rakṣāmatikrāntaḥ| namostu brāhmaṇajanāveditarājyaphalāya| abhidhīyatāṃ kastāvadatrabhavān| devakulikaḥ --- ayaṃ khalu tāvat priyāviyoganirvedaparityaktarājyabhāro nityāvabhṛthasnānapraśāntarajā ajaḥ| bharataḥ --- namo'stuślāghanīyapaścāttāpāya| (daśarathasya pratimāmavalokayan paryākulo bhūtvā|) bhoḥ! bahumānavyākṣiptena manasā suvyaktaṃ nāvadhāritam| abhidhīyatāṃ kastāvadatrabhavān| devakulikaḥ --- ayaṃ dilīpaḥ| bharataḥ --- pitṛpitāmaho mahārājasya| tatastataḥ| devakulikaḥ --- atrabhavān raghuḥ| bharataḥ --- pitāmaho mahārājasya| tatastataḥ| devakulikaḥ --- atrabhavānajaḥ| bharataḥ --- pitā tātasya| kimiti kimiti devakulikaḥ --- ayaṃ dilīpaḥ, ayaṃ raghuḥ, ayamajaḥ| bharataḥ --- bhavantaṃ kiñcit pṛcchāmi| dharamāṇānāmapi pratimāḥ sthāpyante| devakulikaḥ --- na khalu atikrāntānāmeva| bharataḥ --- tena hyāpṛcche bhavantam| devakulikaḥ --- tiṣṭha| yena prāṇāśca rājyaṃ ca strīśulkārthe visarjitāḥ | imāṃ daśarathasya tvaṃ pratimāṃ kiṃ na pṛcchase || 8 || bharataḥ --- hā tāta! (mūrchitaḥ patati| punaḥ pratyāgatya|) hṛdaya bhava sakāmaṃṃ yatkṛte śaṅkase tvaṃ śrṛṇu pitṛnidhanaṃ tad gaccha dhairyaṃ ca tāvat | spṛśati tu yadi nīco māmayaṃ śulnkaśabdastvatha ca bhavati satyaṃ tatra deho viśodhyaḥ || 9 || āryaṃ!| devakulikaḥ --- āryeti iśvākukulālāpaḥ khalvayam| kaścit kaikeyīputro bharato bhavān nanu| bharataḥ --- atha kima athayakim| daśarathaputro bharato'smi na kaikeyyāḥ| devakulikaḥ --- tena hyāpṛcche bhavantam| bharataḥ --- tiṣṭha! śeṣamabhidhīyatām| devakulikaḥ --- kā gatiḥ| śrūyatām| uparatastatrabhavān daśarathaḥ| sītālakṣmaṇasahāyasya rāmasya vanagamanaprayojanaṃ na jāne| bharataḥ --- kathaṃ katham? āryo'pi vanaṃ gata? (dviguṇaṃ mohamupagataḥ|) devakulikaḥ --- kumāra! samāśvasihi samāśvasihi| bharataḥ --- (samāśvasya|) ayodhyāmaṭavībhūtāṃ pitrā bhrātrā ca varjitām | pipāsārto'nudhāvāmi kṣīṇatoyāṃ nadīmiva || 10 || ārya ! vistaraśravaṇaṃ me sthairyamutpādayati| tat sarvamanavaśeṣamabhidhīyatām| devakulikaḥ --- śruyatāṃ tatrabhavatā rājñābhiṣicyamāne tatrabhavati rāme bhavato jananyābhihitaṃ kila| bharataḥ --- tiṣṭha| taṃ smṛtvā śulkadoṣaṃ bhavatu mama suto rājetyabhihitaṃ taddhairyeṇāśvasatyā vraja suta! vanamityāryo'pyabhihitaḥ | taṃ dṛṣṭvā baddhacīraṃ nidhanamasadṛśaṃ rājā nanu gataḥ pātyante dhikpralāpā nanu mayi sadṛśāḥ śeṣāḥ prakṛtibhiḥ || 11 || (nepathye) ussaraha ayyā! ussaraha| (utsaratāryāḥ utsarata|) devakulikaḥ --- (vilokya) aye, kāle khalvāgatā devyaḥ putre mohamupāgate | hastasparśo hi mātṛṇāmajalasya jalāñjaliḥ || 12 || (tataḥ praviśanti devyaḥ sumantraśca|) sumantraḥ --- ita ito bhavatyaḥ| idaṃ gṛhaṃ tat pratimānṛpasya naḥ samucchrayo yasya sa hamryadurlabhaḥ || ayantritairapratihārikāgatairvinā praṇāmaṃ pathikairupāsyate || 13 || (praviśyāvalokya|) bhavatyaḥ! na khalu na khalu praveṣṭavyam| ayaṃ hi patitaḥ ko'pi vayasstha iva pārthivaḥ | devakulikaḥ --- paraśaṅkāmalaṃ kartaṃu gṛhyatāṃ bharato hyayam || 14 || devyaḥ --- (sahasopagamya|) hā jāda! bharada!| (hā jāta! bharata!) bharataḥ --- (kiñcit samāśvasya|) ārya!| sumantraḥ --- jayatu mahā --- (ityardhokte saviṣādam|) aho svarasādṛśyam| manyepratimāstho mahārājo vyāharatīti| bharataḥ --- atha mātṛṇāmidānīṃ kāvasthā| devyaḥ --- jāda! esā ṇo avatthā| (avaguṇṭhamapanayanti|) (jāta! eṣā no'vasthā|) sumantraḥ --- bhavatyaḥ! nigṛhyatāmutkaṇṭhā | bharataḥ --- (sumantraṃ vilokya|) sarvasamudācārasannikarṣastu māṃ sūcayati| kaccit tāta! sumantro bhavān nanu| sumantraḥ --- kumāra! atha kim| sumantro'smi | anvāsyamānaścirajīvadoṣaiḥ kṛtaghrabhāvena viḍambyamānaḥ| ahaṃ hi tasmin nṛpatau vipanne jīvāmi śūnyasya rathasya sūtaḥ || 15 || bharataḥ --- hā tāta! (utthāya|) tāta! abhivādanakramamupadeṣṭumicchāmi mātṛṇām | sumantraḥ --- bāḍham| iyaṃ tatrabhavato rāmasya jananī devī kausalyā | bharataḥ --- amba! anaparāddho'hamabhivādaye | kausalyā --- jāda!ṇissandāyo hohi| (jāta! niḥsantāpo bhava|) bharataḥ --- (ātmagatam|) ākruṣṭa ivāsmyanena| (prakāśam|) anugṛhīto'smi| tatastataḥ | sumantraḥ --- iyaṃ tatrabhavato lakṣmaṇasya jananī devī sumitrā | bharataḥ --- amba! lakṣmaṇenātisandhito'hamabhivādaye | sumitrā --- jāda! jasomāī hohi| (jāta! yaśobhāgī bhava) bharataḥ --- amba!idaṃ prayatiṣye| anugṛhīto'smi| tatastataḥ | sumantraḥ --- iyaṃ te jananī | bharataḥ --- (saroṣamutthāya|) āḥ pāpe! mama mātuśca mātuśca madhyasthā tvaṃ na śobhase | gaṅgāyamunayormadhye kunadīva praveśitā || 16 || kaikeyī --- jāda! kiṃ mae kidaṃ| (jāta! kiṃ mayā kṛtam|) bharataḥ --- kiṃ kṛtamiti vadasi| vayamayaśasā cīreṇāryo nṛpo gṛhamṛtyunā pratataruditaiḥ kṛtsnāyodhyā, mṛgaiḥ saha lakṣmaṇaḥ | dayitatanayāḥ śokenāmbāḥ, snuṣādhvapariśramairdhigiti vacasā cogreṇātmā tvayā nanu yojitāḥ || 17 || kausalyā --- jāda! savvamamudāāramajjhattho kiṃ ṇa vandasi mādaraṃ| (jāta!sarvasamudācāramadhyasthaḥ kiṃ na vandase mātaram|) bharataḥ --- mātaramiti| amba! tvameva me mātā| amba! abhivādaye| kausalyā --- ṇahi ṇahi! iaṃ de jaṇaṇī| (nahi| iyaṃ te jananī|) bharataḥ --- āsīt purā| na tvidānīm| paśyatu bhavatī, tyaktvā snehaṃ śīlasaṅkāntadoṣaiḥ putrāstāvannanvaputrāḥ kriyante | loke'pūrvaṃ sthāpayāmyeṣa dharmaṃ bhartṛdrodastu mātāpyamātā || 18 || kaikeyī --- jāda! mahāraassa saccavaaṇaṃ rakkhantīe mae taha uttaṃ| (jāta! mahārājasya satyavacanaṃ rakṣantyā mayā tathoktam|) bharataḥ --- kimiti kimiti| kaikeyū --- puttao me rājā hodu tti| (putrako me rājā bhavatviti|) bharataḥ --- atha sa idānīmāryo'pi bhavatyāḥ kaḥ | piturme naurasaḥ putro na krameṇābhiṣicyate | dayitā bhrātaro na syuḥ prakṛtīnāṃ na rocate || 19 || kaikeyī --- jāda! sukkaluddhā ṇaṇu pucchidavvā| (jāta! śulkalubdhā nanu praṣṭavyā|) bharataḥ --- valkalairhṛtarājyaśrīḥ padātiḥ saha bhāryayā | vanavāsaṃ tvayājñaptaḥ śulke'pyetadudāhṛtam || 20 || kaikeyī --- jāda! desakāle ṇivademi| (jāta!deśakāle nivedayāmi|) bharataḥ --- ayaśasi yadi lobhaḥ kīrtayitvā kimasmān kimu nṛpaphalatarṣaḥ kiṃ narendro na dadyāt | atha tu nṛpatimātetyeṣa śabdastaveṣṭo vadatu bhavati!
